classes.exactByteIntentVerbatim: Once authored: one cell per admitted external role (D-002 slice-1: the TypeScript provider only) and per surface in the slash-joined set {human, JSON, SARIF, doctor, fault, config, progress, log}, on each D-002 platform. Each cell retains the four live-cell members as they apply to that role × surface. Human and JSON cells retain host-owned projections of the same structured envelope. SARIF cells retain the live axis and record that preview analyze does not advertise SARIF 2.1.0; they do not restore G17 advertised-parity fixtures and do not execute harness.DR-G26.preview-analyze-sarif-not-advertised. Doctor cells retain host-owned doctor integration; they do not author G12 FC implementations, doctor schema, D9 mapping, or purge. Fault cells retain structured fault-envelope / diagnostic host projection; they do not execute G21 crash/panic/timeout/resource/malformed/truncated/duplicate/EOF/process-tree/recovery. Config cells retain schema-checked configuration with provenance and brokered secret handles; they do not invent DR-108 storage mechanics and do not score G09 requested/granted/denied tables. Progress cells retain host-owned progress/status projection of component-emitted progress. Log cells retain structured logging and audit correlation; they do not admit unstructured host logs. A second slice-1 language role is not a cell. Windows is not a cell. Fixtures are unauthored.
classes.passPropertyVerbatim: Every admitted-role × {human, JSON, SARIF, doctor, fault, config, progress, log} cell is present on all four D-002 platforms. A skipped role, surface, or platform is not a waiver. SARIF cells record preview non-advertisement and do not restore G17. SDK-implementation variance is not a skipped cell. G12, G21, G15, G22, G09, G17, and G26 are not scored as this class. Pass all four D-002 platforms.
